reason: Two incompatible changes ship in 0.3.6: the coordinates 0.3.0 through 0.3.4 were attested to a revision whose release quality gate failed, and release objects are immutable, so that coordinate is spent. First, the release archive no longer contains the launcher's trust material: the signed policy, workload registry, trust root, receipt command and workload proof key moved out of etc/brama-skarbiec and are generated per installation by bin/provision-skarbiec-trust. start-with-skarbiec refuses to start until they exist, so an installation that relied on the bundled copy stops working until it is provisioned and its capabilities are re-granted. Second, BRAMA_CREDENTIAL_AUTOMATIC_SIGN_IN is gone: signing an account in through Weles after a provider refusal is what the gateway does rather than a setting, so a deployment that left the variable unset now gets the escalation it names, and the account and admin sign-in routes answer 409 instead of 502 when this deployment's own declarations are what block one. RELEASE.md counts the release archive layout, launcher behavior and environment fields as public contract, and the command list tests/versioning/surface.py extracts cannot see any of them, which is why this declaration exists.
